credits.overview: It's about Alia, a beautiful toddler who was found by an old fisherman. As she grows up, Alia tries to find out who her parents are and discovers the fact that she was almost betrothed to the jinn when she was still a child.

credits.title: Kuyank
credits.overview: Seven years prior to the breach of the mystical Saranjana portal, a remote stilt village built upon the treacherous swamps of interior Kalimantan becomes the epicenter of a terrifying theological crisis as the grotesque mechanics of an ancient black magic curse—the Kuyang—are violently unearthed.

credits.title: Angél Pol
credits.overview: Jati and Lastri form a traveling “dangdut” orchestra with a truck to survive among marginalized communities.

credits.title: The Immortal Witch
credits.overview: A group of friends on a pre-wedding photoshoot at a luxurious and vintage villa unexpectedly find themselves trapped in the sacred lair of Mak Lampir, who is said to crave eternal beauty. Can they survive Mak Lampir's deadly game?

credits.overview: An Indonesian fashion designer studying in England finds her career compromised by an intoxicating love affair that challenges her dreams and values.
